name: openapi-compatible-copilot
description: OpenAI-compatible OR Anthropic for Copilot Chat

openapicopilot.systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt to prepend to system messages

openapicopilot.language.description: Display language for the LLS OAI UI. Auto follows the VS Code display language.

openapicopilot.expertMode.enabled.description: Enable expert mode. When enabled, the main model can delegate difficult tasks to a selected expert model.

openapicopilot.expertMode.enabledState.description: Workspace expert mode enabled state. Use global, force enabled, or force disabled for this workspace.

openapicopilot.expertMode.providerId.description: Provider ID used by expert mode.

openapicopilot.expertMode.modelId.description: Model ID used by expert mode.

openapicopilot.solutionProvider.enabled.description: Enable solution provider. When enabled, the main model can delegate planning and solution design tasks to a selected solution model.

openapicopilot.solutionProvider.enabledS.description: Workspace solution provider enabled state. Use global, force enabled, or force disabled for this workspace.

openapicopilot.solutionProvider.provider.description: Provider ID used by solution provider.

openapicopilot.solutionProvider.modelId.description: Model ID used by solution provider.

openapicopilot.solutionProvider.reviewWi.description: When enabled and expert mode is available, the solution provider model must call ask_llsoai at least once to review the proposed solution before finalizing. This is a global setting.
Workspace solution provider expert review state. Use global, force enabled, or force disabled for this workspace.

openapicopilot.promptEnhancement.enabled.description: Enable prompt enhancement. When enabled, prompts can be automatically optimized by a selected model before requests.

openapicopilot.promptEnhancement.autoSen.description: Automatically submit the optimized prompt after inserting it into chat input.

openapicopilot.promptEnhancement.enabled.description: Workspace prompt enhancement enabled state. Use global, force enabled, or force disabled for this workspace.

openapicopilot.promptEnhancement.autoSen.description: Workspace prompt enhancement auto-send state. Use global, force enabled, or force disabled for this workspace.

openapicopilot.promptEnhancement.provide.description: Provider ID used by prompt enhancement.

openapicopilot.promptEnhancement.modelId.description: Model ID used by prompt enhancement.

openapicopilot.promptEnhancement.context.description: Maximum number of recent messages cached per session for prompt enhancement context. 0 means unlimited by message count.
